lessons.title: Prepare website files
lessons.explain: Organize HTML, CSS, JavaScript and assets. Confirm index.html is at the publish root.
lessons.question: Which file should normally be served as the homepage?
lessons.task: Inspect the project tree, locate index.html, and confirm CSS and image paths are relative to the published root.
lessons.expected: A valid homepage file and working asset paths.
lessons.caution: Do not upload secrets or private client data.

lessons.title: Upload a project to GitHub
lessons.explain: Create a repository, add website files, commit changes and inspect the repository.
lessons.question: What is a saved change in Git usually called?
lessons.task: Add index.html, styles.css and an assets folder to the mock repository, then create a commit.
lessons.expected: The repository contains the expected files and a commit.
lessons.caution: Never commit passwords, API keys or client credentials.

lessons.title: Deploy a website
lessons.explain: Connect a repository to a host, choose a publish directory and inspect deployment results.
lessons.question: What should you check first if a deployment returns a 404?
lessons.task: Choose the sample repository and publish directory, then diagnose a failed deployment.
lessons.expected: The live URL loads the homepage, styles and images.
lessons.caution: A wrong publish directory or missing index.html commonly causes a 404.

lessons.title: Understand DNS
lessons.explain: Learn how domain names resolve to hosting and why DNS changes take time.
lessons.question: Which record type commonly maps a hostname to an IPv4 address?
lessons.task: Inspect a sample DNS zone and match record types to their purposes.
lessons.expected: You can explain A, CNAME, MX and nameserver roles.
lessons.caution: Do not change existing production records without client approval.

lessons.title: Configure A and CNAME records
lessons.explain: Create and inspect records for apex and www hostnames.
lessons.question: Which record type points a hostname to another hostname?
lessons.task: Correct the sample www record using the supplied fictional hosting target.
lessons.expected: The apex and www hostnames point to the intended host.
lessons.caution: Use the exact values supplied by the hosting provider.

lessons.title: SSL and HTTPS
lessons.explain: Understand certificates, HTTPS and common domain validation issues.
lessons.question: What protocol should a public business website use?
lessons.task: Review a simulated certificate status and resolve the DNS prerequisite.
lessons.expected: The site loads over HTTPS without certificate warnings.
lessons.caution: Certificate issuance depends on correct domain configuration.

lessons.title: Choose an email provider
lessons.explain: Compare domain email hosting, mailboxes, aliases and account access.
lessons.question: Does owning a domain automatically create an email inbox?
lessons.task: Choose an email hosting plan for a fictional small business and identify what is included.
lessons.expected: A mailbox is provisioned by an email provider.
lessons.caution: A domain alone does not create an inbox; paid plans may be required.

lessons.title: Configure MX records
lessons.explain: Understand how mail exchangers route incoming messages.
lessons.question: Which DNS record routes incoming email?
lessons.task: Enter the sample provider MX records into the simulated DNS editor.
lessons.expected: The provider's required MX records are entered exactly as documented.
lessons.caution: Never guess MX hosts or priorities.

lessons.title: SPF, DKIM and DMARC
lessons.explain: Learn sender authentication and how to validate records.
lessons.question: Which record helps specify authorized sending sources?
lessons.task: Review a sample authentication panel and identify the missing SPF, DKIM or DMARC item.
lessons.expected: Authentication records match the email provider's instructions.
lessons.caution: Avoid duplicate SPF records; test before enforcing strict DMARC.

lessons.title: Plan a signature
lessons.explain: Choose useful contact details, visual hierarchy and accessible styling.
lessons.question: What makes an email signature useful?
lessons.task: Select appropriate contact details for a fictional salon signature.
lessons.expected: The signature is concise, accurate and readable on mobile.
lessons.caution: Avoid oversized banners and unnecessary personal information.

lessons.title: Build an HTML signature
lessons.explain: Use simple HTML and inline styling for email-client compatibility.
lessons.question: Which HTML attribute makes an email link open a new message?
lessons.task: Edit the sample signature fields and preview the result.
lessons.expected: Links work and the layout remains readable on narrow screens.
lessons.caution: Email clients may strip advanced CSS; keep markup simple.

lessons.title: Install and test a signature
lessons.explain: Add the signature in Gmail or Outlook and send a test message.
lessons.question: What should you do after installing a signature?
lessons.task: Choose the correct mock settings and inspect a test email preview.
lessons.expected: The signature appears in new messages and replies as intended.
lessons.caution: Test on desktop and mobile.

lessons.title: Design a favicon
lessons.explain: Create a simple square icon that remains recognizable at small sizes.
lessons.question: What kind of design works best at 16–32 pixels?
lessons.task: Choose a clear icon and review it at small preview sizes.
lessons.expected: The icon remains recognizable when tiny.
lessons.caution: Avoid tiny text and overly complex illustrations.

lessons.title: Generate favicon files
lessons.explain: Prepare favicon.ico and modern PNG or SVG variants where supported.
lessons.question: What is the purpose of favicon.ico?
lessons.task: Select the appropriate sample favicon package for a website.
lessons.expected: The site has suitable icon files and references.
lessons.caution: Keep file names and paths consistent.

lessons.title: Add and verify a favicon
lessons.explain: Reference favicon files in the HTML head and test browser display.
lessons.question: Which HTML element references a favicon?
lessons.task: Repair the broken favicon path in the sample HTML head.
lessons.expected: The browser tab displays the intended icon.
lessons.caution: Check path casing and cache if an old icon remains.

lessons.title: Keyword research
lessons.explain: Understand search intent and choose realistic relevant phrases.
lessons.question: What should a primary keyword match?
lessons.task: Choose a primary phrase and supporting terms for a local salon page.
lessons.expected: Keywords match the page's service, location and search intent.
lessons.caution: Do not stuff keywords or target unrelated phrases.

lessons.title: Titles and descriptions
lessons.explain: Write unique page titles and useful meta descriptions.
lessons.question: Which HTML element sets the document title?
lessons.task: Correct duplicate or vague metadata in the sample page editor.
lessons.expected: Each important page has a descriptive, unique title and accurate description.
lessons.caution: Meta descriptions are suggestions, not guaranteed search snippets.

lessons.title: Headings, images and links
lessons.explain: Use semantic heading hierarchy, meaningful alt text and helpful internal links.
lessons.question: What should informative image alt text describe?
lessons.task: Fix the sample heading order and add meaningful alt text.
lessons.expected: Content is understandable to visitors and search engines.
lessons.caution: Decorative images should usually have empty alt text.

lessons.title: Read an SEO audit
lessons.explain: Understand crawl reports, issue severity and page-level evidence.
lessons.question: What should an SEO finding include?
lessons.task: Prioritize sample missing titles, duplicate descriptions and broken links.
lessons.expected: Findings are tied to specific URLs and evidence.
lessons.caution: A tool warning is not automatically a ranking problem.

lessons.title: Inspect indexing
lessons.explain: Use Search Console to inspect URLs, sitemap status and indexing reports.
lessons.question: Does submitting a URL guarantee indexing?
lessons.task: Interpret a fictional URL inspection result and choose the next action.
lessons.expected: You can distinguish crawling, indexing and serving status.
lessons.caution: Submitting a URL does not guarantee indexing.

lessons.title: Use AI responsibly
lessons.explain: Give AI structured page data, request suggestions and verify each recommendation.
lessons.question: Should AI-generated SEO recommendations be checked before publishing?
lessons.task: Review AI suggestions and approve or reject each recommendation.
lessons.expected: Approved changes are accurate, human-reviewed and tested.
lessons.caution: Never paste passwords or confidential customer information.

lessons.title: Read a performance report
lessons.explain: Understand lab and field data and Core Web Vitals.
lessons.question: What does LCP measure?
lessons.task: Interpret sample LCP, INP and CLS findings and identify the priority.
lessons.expected: You can explain which metric needs attention and why.
lessons.caution: A single performance score is not the whole user experience.

lessons.title: Optimize images
lessons.explain: Resize and compress images; use modern formats where supported.
lessons.question: Name one modern image format useful for web delivery.
lessons.task: Choose a smaller image variant that preserves acceptable visual quality.
lessons.expected: Images are appropriately sized, compressed and delivered efficiently.
lessons.caution: Do not sacrifice legibility or serve oversized originals.

lessons.title: Improve loading behavior
lessons.explain: Apply lazy loading to offscreen images and reduce unnecessary resources.
lessons.question: What loading value is commonly used for offscreen images?
lessons.task: Correct image loading attributes and identify unnecessary resources.
lessons.expected: The page loads efficiently without breaking layout or interactions.
lessons.caution: Do not lazy-load the main above-the-fold hero image by default.

lessons.title: Plan the launch
lessons.explain: Confirm scope, access, approvals, backup and acceptance criteria.
lessons.question: What is required before changing a live client domain?
lessons.task: Organize a fictional client request into a safe launch sequence.
lessons.expected: The plan identifies dependencies, owners, evidence and approval points.
lessons.caution: Never change production settings without client authorization.

lessons.title: Execute and verify
lessons.explain: Complete deployment, domain, email, favicon, SEO and performance checks.
lessons.question: When is a task really complete?
lessons.task: Work through a simulated launch board and resolve blockers.
lessons.expected: Each task has a verified result and evidence.
lessons.caution: Keep a rollback plan and record changes.

lessons.title: Deliver professionally
lessons.explain: Prepare a concise handover, known limitations and maintenance notes.
lessons.question: What should a client handover contain?
lessons.task: Complete the launch report and select the evidence the client needs.
lessons.expected: The client receives links, completed work, test results and next steps.
lessons.caution: Do not promise search rankings or guaranteed email deliverability.
